remarks: Fully renovated and thoughtfully expanded, this stunning Norwalk home offers modern living with exceptional space and style. Now featuring 5 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, the property has been completely updated with high-end finishes throughout. The brand-new kitchen showcases elegant quartz countertops, new stainless steel appliances, and stylish fixtures, creating the perfect space for both everyday living and entertaining. Bathrooms have been beautifully upgraded with contemporary finishes, including smart toilets for added comfort and convenience. Additional improvements include a new roof and numerous modern upgrades throughout the home. The flexible floor plan provides generous living space ideal for today's lifestyle, whether for extended family, guests, or home office needs. Set on a spacious lot in a convenient Norwalk location close to shopping, dining, and major commuting routes, this move-in-ready home combines modern upgrades with expanded living space for a truly turnkey opportunity.
